Key candidates with small black structures on stalk rind: Diplodia_Stalk_Rot (small black pycnidia embedded in rind), Charcoal_Stalk_Rot (tiny black sclerotia inside pith).

This reference image is nearly identical to the test image — same angle, same stalk structure, same tan/brown coloration, same small dark specks on the rind surface, same background. This is a strong match for Diplodia_Stalk_Rot.
